claims.claim: micro1 positions itself as an AI data lab, with Realm for training and evaluation environments, Cortex for enterprise-agent evaluation, and Robotics for embodied-system data.

micro1 Robotics covers expert first-person and third-person demonstrations; data structuring, annotation, quality control and evaluation; synchronized stereo, IMU and multicamera capture; and controlled deployment-lab work with robots.

flow distinguishes generation, data-quality checking and grading of model outputs, with expert review, correction and linked camera and 3D evidence. Used here as conceptual alignment only; no integration is claimed.
micro1's July robotics research emphasizes task-specific post-training data and matching deployment conditions.
micro1's September safety research favors simulation for hazardous tests and bounded hardware experiments.
A company repost announces a Malibu robotics data lab and hiring for hardware-focused work. Relative post timestamps should be rechecked.

A public Video Capture Partner USA listing seeks B2B vendors for smartphone POV and sensor collection with approved-output compensation, refers to LATAM-based vendor firms, and limits deployed contributors to 26 named US states. California and Arizona are not listed.

micro1's enterprise data-partnership program licenses operational knowledge and documentation and targets mature companies, including those with 30+ employees. It is distinct from commissioning new robotics demonstrations.
micro1 runs an expert certification and matching program. Remote evaluation expertise is a different staffing requirement from local, qualified on-site operators.
